name: Local community clothing drive
description: Ask a nearby community center about current clothing drives and requested sizes. Confirm dates and accepted items before visiting.

name: Neighborhood charity shop
description: Clean, wearable clothing can find another owner. Check the shop’s current donation guidelines and drop-off hours.

name: Textile reuse or recycling center
description: For pieces that cannot be repaired or worn, look for a local textile reuse program. Confirm material and condition requirements first.
